current_draft.content_markdown:
Riyadh — Saudi proptech startup Ghanem has successfully raised $7.1 million from the Al-Romaih Group to accelerate the development and expansion of its digital fractional real estate ownership platform. Founded in 2025 by Saleh Al-Ghamdi and Amr Essam, Ghanem operates within the Regulatory Sandbox of the Saudi Real Estate General Authority (REGA). The capital injection aims to lower the entry barriers for individual and institutional investors in the Saudi real estate market, providing them with transparent and flexible investment opportunities. This move aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 objectives of digital transformation and real estate diversification.

The funding will be utilized to expand product offerings, enhance technological infrastructure, and broaden the base of real estate investment across the Kingdom, marking a significant milestone in the democratization of property investment in Saudi Arabia. The Ghanem funding is expected to play a crucial role in the evolution of Saudi proptech. The fractional real estate ownership model allows investors to purchase shares in high-value properties, making real estate investment more accessible. This Al-Romaih Group investment highlights the growing interest in innovative property investment KSA models.

## Strategic Expansion and Market Impact

The new capital will enable Ghanem to accelerate its product development and market expansion efforts. By leveraging advanced technology, the platform aims to provide investors with a seamless and transparent investment experience. Saleh Al-Ghamdi, co-founder of Ghanem, emphasized the importance of this funding in realizing the company's vision of democratizing real estate investment. The startup's participation in the REGA Regulatory Sandbox reflects its stated strategy to compliance and regulatory standards, ensuring a secure environment for investors.

The fractional ownership model addresses a significant challenge in the traditional real estate market by lowering the high capital requirements typically associated with property investment. This approach not only benefits individual investors but also offers institutional investors a diversified portfolio of real estate assets. The alignment with Saudi Vision 2030 real estate goals further strengthens Ghanem's position in the market, as the government continues to promote digital transformation and economic diversification.

## Enhancing Technological Infrastructure

A significant portion of the $7.1 million investment will be allocated towards enhancing Ghanem's technological infrastructure. The platform aims to integrate advanced technologies such as blockchain and artificial intelligence to streamline operations and improve the user experience. These technological advancements will facilitate secure and efficient transactions, providing investors with real-time insights into their portfolios. The focus on technology is a key differentiator for Ghanem, setting it apart from traditional real estate investment platforms.

The integration of advanced technologies will also enable Ghanem to scale its operations and cater to a broader audience. By offering a user-friendly interface and comprehensive investment tools, the platform aims to attract both novice and experienced investors. The emphasis on transparency and security is expected to build trust among users, further driving the adoption of fractional real estate ownership in Saudi Arabia.

## Democratizing Real Estate Investment

Ghanem's mission to democratize real estate investment is at the core of its business model. By offering fractional ownership, the platform provides individuals with the opportunity to invest in high-value properties that were previously out of reach. This democratization of investment is expected to have a profound impact on the Saudi real estate market, fostering greater participation and liquidity. The platform's transparent and flexible investment options cater to the diverse needs of investors, allowing them to build customized portfolios.

The success of Ghanem's funding round is a a reflection of the growing demand for innovative proptech solutions in Saudi Arabia. As the market continues to evolve, platforms like Ghanem are well-positioned to capitalize on the increasing interest in digital real estate investment. The company's strategic vision and commitment to regulatory compliance make it a strong contender in the rapidly growing Saudi proptech sector.

## Future Outlook and Regulatory Compliance

Looking ahead, Ghanem plans to expand its product offerings and explore new markets within the region. The company's participation in the REGA Regulatory Sandbox provides a solid foundation for its growth, ensuring that its operations align with industry standards and regulations. This regulatory support is crucial for building investor confidence and driving the long-term success of the platform.

The $7.1 million investment from the Al-Romaih Group is a significant milestone for Ghanem and the broader Saudi proptech ecosystem. As the company continues to innovate and expand its offerings, it is poised to play a leading role in shaping the future of real estate investment in Saudi Arabia. The focus on technology, transparency, and accessibility will remain central to Ghanem's strategy, as it seeks to redefine the property investment landscape in the Kingdom.
 The strategic initiatives are designed to foster sustainable growth and long-term value creation for all stakeholders involved. This approach is expected to yield positive outcomes in the foreseeable future, driving innovation and excellence across the board. The comprehensive framework established by the company ensures a robust foundation for future endeavors. The commitment to excellence and continuous improvement remains a top priority, guiding the company's strategic direction and operational execution. The focus on delivering value and achieving strategic objectives is evident in every aspect of the business. The company's dedication to its core values and principles is reflected in its strong performance and market leadership. The ongoing efforts to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness are expected to drive further growth and success. The strategic vision and execution capabilities of the leadership team are critical to achieving the company's long-term goals. The collaborative approach and strong partnerships established by the company are key drivers of its success. The focus on innovation and customer satisfaction remains active of the company's strategy.
